sources.title: The Complexity of Theorem-Proving Procedures
sources.use: Historical source for bounded nondeterministic computation to propositional satisfiability. Our proof uses direct circuit unrolling and explicit unique-extension constraints.

sources.title: Reducibility Among Combinatorial Problems
sources.use: Primary paper reprinted with Karp's 2010 introduction; source for classical graph/integer completeness framework. Digit construction and witness-bijection audit are developed explicitly in this report.

sources.authors: Bengt Aspvall, Michael F. Plass, Robert Endre Tarjan
sources.title: A Linear-Time Algorithm for Testing the Truth of Certain Quantified Boolean Formulas
sources.use: Theorem 1 gives the implication-graph SCC criterion for 2SAT. Our polynomial algorithm uses explicit reachability and predecessor-count keys instead of invoking the linear-time SCC algorithm.
